svg.title: Hisaab data model: everything stays in the browser

g.text: Hisaab data model: everything stays in the browser

g.id: cluster_Files the owner saves or loads
g.text: Files the owner saves or loads
PK primary key, FK foreign key
solid line: held inside the same document
dotted line: linked by value only, nothing enforces it
"made from": the file is written from these records
light blue: on the device (localStorage, cache)
grey: files the owner saves or loads
a WhatsApp or SMS message, a pay link, or a file the owner shares.
